title: Mixed Event — Let SEKAI Hear Your Song! — Episode1 Let's Show Support!

meta.Event Outline: The VIRTUAL SINGERS of each SEKAI see how everyone is progressing toward their goals. They are excitedly preparing ways to demonstrate their support for everyone, when something extraordinary happens.

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
It's so nice to see you all again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And thank you for always watching over the others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Speaking of which, it's been some time since you all started coming here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Quite a lot happened during that time, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They discovered their true feelings, which led to so many songs being born in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And now, they're trying to take their next big steps.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Isn't this so exciting?
I'm very much looking forward to seeing how they all grow!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, look...!
Our other selves from SEKAI seem to be doing something!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know! Why don't we go take a quick peek?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ready? Here we go!
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll see you all again next time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Bye bye, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Bye bye☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe☆
Another day, another really fun practice!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was fun!
I didn't think their improv show would end up being so good.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I started tearing up towards the end!
I still can't believe they ad-libbed the whole thing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The story was very good, but they also had so much chemistry. Not to mention that their acting was very animated.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. They were all very into it. I can't help but feel inspired by them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That must be because they've grown and gone through so much together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They've become so much stronger since the first time they came to SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They persevered in the face of hardship and never wavered. I suspect they were able to do that because they kept dreaming big.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. Making both their dreams as a group and their individual dreams come true seemed almost impossible.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But after giving it an enormous amount of thought, weighing their options and working together, they found a way to stick together...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure they'll face more obstacles along the way, but my hope is that those won't stop them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, I kinda want to do something for Tsukasa and the others.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do something for them...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Because they've been trying really, really hard!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And they made the decision to leave the Wonder Stage to set out into the world!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
In other words, you'd like to show them your support somehow.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, exactly☆
I want them to know that we're here for them!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's sounds wonderful! I'd love to help!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Show them our support somehow...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, let's do a show☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One that'll really demonstrate our support for them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We're going to demonstrate our support for Minori and the others by doing a show for them?
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Exactly! I thought we could do one as a way to say that we're there for them since they're reaching toward new heights...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But how do we actually do that? Any ideas?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... What about a medley of songs that are really happy and full of energy?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, I like where you're going with that!
But I think it needs to also feel a little special in some way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why don't we perform the songs that they have during their past shows?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Perform their songs?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, we could sing and perform dance routines that they themselves have done.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They've worked tirelessly to create wonderful things and spread hope to others. So, I thought we could show them what they've achieved.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... That's an amazing idea!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm all for that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, let's start getting everything together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: After we've come up with a set list, we'll decide who's in charge of what and figure out what to do for each dance.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, and costumes!
Also...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. KAITO sounds so excited.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
He really does!
I'm guessing his excitement level's only going to keep increasing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But that means we should also feel just as motivated. This is for them after all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, let's do our best to put on a wonderful show!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why the long face?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: When Mafuyu went to tell her mom how she really felt that time...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I heard that hearing Miku sing Kanade's song helped settle her down.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ena also felt better after she heard me sing that time...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, I wanna learn how to be a better singer... For them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone in each SEKAI seems to be doing their best to show the others their support.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder what's going on in the other SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why don't we go take a look?!
